1435bdb3d	Per Task
1435bdb47	Each task will constantly monitor the selected store at the specificed monitor delay. This will ensure you have the highest chance of picking up the product fast but uses more data and increases your chances of getting banned.
1435bdc2a	Shared Monitor
1435bdc3a	Only a few tasks will monitor the selected store at the specified monitor delay. The products found will then be shared across all tasks. This uses less data and allows you to set lower delays. You can configure the amount of monitoring tasks in settings.
1435bdd3a	In-bot Monitor
1435bdd4a	Tasks will wait for the in-bot monitor to detect a new product or restock and use the data provided by the monitor. While using this mode, no data will be used while searching for a product/restock.
